title: Pediatric continuous seizure-event detection
scientific_question: Can a neural detector find annotated seizures while maintaining low false alarms across full held-out-patient recordings?
primary_outputs: Sample scores and merged predicted seizure intervals, with fixed threshold and context policy.

data_manifest.count_caveat: Live RECORDS contains 686 EDF paths, while publisher descriptive prose still says 664. Use the pinned actual manifest; chb24 was added later.

recording_contract.neural: Actual representative EDF header has 23 bipolar EEG channels at 256 Hz, microvolt units, and 3,600 one-second records. Montage and duplicate labels vary across files; never infer all channels are distinct electrodes.
recording_contract.labels: Per-case summary files give seizure starts/ends in recording-relative seconds; companion .edf.seizures files also exist. Actual chb01_03 event is 2996–3036 s.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Summary onset/offset is relative to the EDF recording. Gaps between files must not be treated as observed background. Pinned parser matches the exact EDF filename and reads its event interval.
recording_contract.biological_ids: chb01 and chb21 are the same biological person approximately 1.5 years apart; official converter maps chb21 to subject01/session02. Split 23 people, not 24 folder names. chb24 age/sex missing in SUBJECT-INFO.
recording_contract.evidence: 686-path manifest, SUBJECT-INFO, actual summary, 6,144-byte EDF header, source alias mapping and label parser inspected; no signal samples downloaded.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Group by biological patient, explicitly chb01=chb21; split complete recordings; keep complete eligible background and file gaps.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Patient-macro event F1; mandatory event sensitivity and false alarms per 24 observed hours.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.

source_storage_evidence.bounded_intake_plan: One seizure-bearing and one background record per selected person for schema/positive-control setup, then complete monitoring periods for an honest false-alarm assessment.
source_storage_evidence.compute_estimate: CPU feature-baseline scope is plausible; throughput and RAM unmeasured. Full monitoring is much larger than a balanced epoch demonstration.
